events.name: Light Don Go
events.text: Grid power is out. The generator kicks in and diesel burns twice as fast today.

events.name: Trader Went Viral
events.text: A shoe seller's Shop Page is trending. More businesses queue at the sales desk today.

events.name: Bug in Production
events.text: A release broke checkout. Developers are fixing it, so features ship slowly today.

events.name: Hackathon Win
events.text: Your juniors won a weekend hackathon. Everyone works faster today.

events.name: Rival Poaching
events.text: ZapPadi tried to hire your senior dev. She stays, but the team is distracted. Fewer sign-ups today.

events.name: Server Parts Stuck
events.text: The delivery truck is held at the port. Server parts arrive slowly today.

events.name: Clean Audit
events.text: The data audit passed with no issues. Big companies join the queue today.

events.name: School Fees Season
events.text: Schools are collecting fees with Pay Link. Payment income is up today.
